industry: Measuring, Medical, Optical and Related Instruments

instrument_device_family.label: Instrument / device family
instrument_device_family.value: Quality control and process monitoring instruments: sensors, air samplers, dialysate meters, cap torque testers, plus bioscience tools (Agena, Gyros)

measurement_performance_specification.label: Measurement / performance specification
measurement_performance_specification.value: Precision, traceable measurement; NIST-traceable calibration; EPA-compliant particulate sampling accuracy

clinical_industrial_research_use.label: Clinical / industrial / research use
clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Pharma and medical device manufacturing, healthcare, environmental monitoring, and biomedical research and clinical laboratories

product_specific_regulatory_status.label: Product-specific regulatory status
product_specific_regulatory_status.value: Largely nonmedical quality-control instruments; EPA-compliant samplers; ISO 13485 certified, ISO 17025 accredited, 21 CFR Part 11 compliant systems

consumables_service_attachment.label: Consumables / service attachment
consumables_service_attachment.value: Calibration solutions and services alongside instruments; consumables for quality control and bioscience (e.g., indicators, reagents)

calibration_qualification_requirement.label: Calibration / qualification requirement
calibration_qualification_requirement.value: NIST-traceable calibration; ISO/IEC 17025-accredited calibration lab; validation and compliance monitoring for regulated processes

notes: Specific numeric accuracy specifications are not in the evidence; consumables detail is partly from general knowledge.
